blurb: This was an amazing experience. My instructor was William, [and] he was amazing. He did a great job of pointing out landmarks, videotaping, and making the experience less scary for me. After being strapped to William, I never again felt afraid, even at 10,000 feet. Free falling was the most amazing experience, it is like nothing else I’ve ever done and I would recommend it to anyone.
